name: DTU Planner
description: A planning tree for work at DTU: teaching, research, projects, duties and people in one mind map. Deadlines raise urgency as they approach, timelines track the steps before them, an Urgent × Critical matrix shows what comes first, and a calendar puts it all on one page with Danish holidays and DTU periods. Editions per month or term, a journal of every save, notifications and a morning summary. Free and open source (MIT); the installed version updates itself.
note: Windows desktop app: download the installer (not code-signed, so Windows asks once: More info, Run anyway).
